baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus nouns and verb join favors, the dual addressees' Lord, and declaring false.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed favors are treated as attributable acts of sovereign nurture, so denial is an accountable verdict about a giver's work rather than a neutral failure to notice benefits.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the concrete objects placed under question.
Lordship, ownership, and authority make the favors attributable and the response answerable.
Repair, nurture, and completion recast lordship as formative care.
Declaring something false supplies the explicit act challenged by the question.

changed_reading.before: Which blessings do you two deny?
changed_reading.after: Which attributable acts of your owning, repairing, completing Lord do you two jointly declare false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots retain oath, pact, obligation, and failed-charge branches alongside the ordinary favor-denial sense.
baseline_models.mechanism: An oath-like bestowal and a lordly pact create a charge; takdhib is then not only false speech but failure to carry the charge faithfully.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies a binding rather than merely descriptive force to the favors.
A covenant or pact makes lordship the source of a binding relation.
The urging or obligation formula turns the question into a summons to respond.
Fulfilling or failing a charge makes denial a breach in performance.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are accused of holding a false belief about favors.
changed_reading.after: The addressees are summoned over which binding favors and lordly charges they will fail to honor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus combines branches of capacity and falling short with branches of delayed, failed, or arrested performance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can test whether granted capacity reaches its expected completion: denial occurs when response lags, a charge fails, or an initiated movement stops.

activation_trace.role: Falling short or lagging supplies the deficit side of response.
Capacity supplies what the addressees are able and therefore answerable to enact.
A charge that succeeds or fails turns denial into an outcome, not only a statement.
Running and then stopping gives nonperformance an arrested-motion image.

changed_reading.after: Denial may also be the failure to carry gifted capacity and an initiated response through to completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching discloses, expression makes meaning legible, calculation counts, and the balance compares without short measure. The refrain becomes a recurring calibration test: denial is a verdict that undercounts disclosed evidence or makes the entrusted measure fail.

activation_trace.role: Success or failure of a charge lets the final verdict itself be evaluated.
Disclosure to a knower supplies evidence made cognitively available.
Meaning uncovered by speech or sign makes the evidence articulable.
Counting and calculation supply the operation of exact reckoning.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies a calibrated comparison.
Giving short measure names the distortion that denial performs on the evidence.

structural_cues: 55:2-9 moves in order from teaching and disclosure to calculation, balance, and the prohibition of short measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure and measurement; I supply the arrow that a truth verdict must be calibrated by that measure. A live alternative is that the balance remains ethical and commercial rather than epistemic.

changed_reading.before: The refrain asks whether favors are denied.
changed_reading.after: The refrain audits whether the addressees will undercount disclosed signs and return a verdict out of balance with the evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Justice, exposure by marks, and being taken for wrongdoing make warning and consequence parts of repairing lordship. The repeated label of favors can therefore include limits that disclose and correct, not only pleasant provisions.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors provide the category whose range is being revised.
Repair and completion allow constraint and correction to function within nurture.
The balance of justice supplies the norm that corrective scenes enforce.
Recognition by an effect or mark makes judgment an act of exposure.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing gives the correction consequential force.

structural_cues: The identical refrain follows both provision scenes and the warning and judgment sequence in 55:31-45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one refrain across bounty and judgment; I infer that boundary, warning, and exposure may themselves serve reparative favor. Alternatively, the refrain may contrast rejected mercy with punishment without classifying punishment as favor.

changed_reading.before: Favors are pleasant gifts that can be denied.
changed_reading.after: The favors under question may also include just limits, warnings, and exposure that repair by preventing or answering destructive excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah alternates manifest human presence with hidden beings and gardens, then repeatedly brings hidden contents out or identifies agents by visible marks. Denial becomes refusal of an abductive passage from visible trace to concealed source and order.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false names the rejected conclusion of the trace-to-source inference.
Manifest humanity supplies the visible pole opposed to hiddenness.
Hidden beings supply an agentive reality not exhausted by what is seen.
Bringing a thing out of concealment models effects emerging from an unseen interior.
Recognition after an effect or sign supplies the inferential operation.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known supplies inspectable evidence.
The hidden interior of a thing keeps the unseen side materially present within the garden description.

structural_cues: Human and jinn recur as a paired visible-hidden audience while pearls emerge, criminals become legible, and inner linings are named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, emergence, and recognition by marks; I infer a hidden cause from visible effects. A live alternative is that these are separate descriptive scenes with no shared epistemic arrow.

changed_reading.before: The addressees reject explicitly named gifts.
changed_reading.after: The addressees reject the warranted inference from visible effects and marks to the concealed giver, agents, and ordering that produced them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Release, travel, penetration, continuing provision, and gushing water form a circuit of enabled movement. Against that circuit, the focus branch of running then stopping makes denial the point where received motion fails to become responsive motion.

activation_trace.role: An animal running and then stopping supplies the image of response arrested mid-course.
Release into open movement initiates the contextual flow mechanism.
Running and streaming carry the mechanism through maritime movement.
Continuous provision turns flow from mere motion into sustained giving.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the contrast of completed versus blocked transit.
Abundant water bursting forth culminates the image of productive flow.

structural_cues: Seas, ships, attempted passage, running springs, and gushing springs recur before the final settled garden scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated enabled and blocked movement; I assign human denial the role of interruption in the circuit from gift to recognition. Alternatively, the motion imagery may only display range and abundance.

changed_reading.after: Denial is an arrested response that breaks the ongoing passage from released provision to recognition and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Manifest humans and hidden jinn are repeatedly placed in a world of counterparts that meet and pair. The dual verbs and pronouns can therefore make each class a counterwitness whose denial is tested beside the other's access to the same ordered field.

activation_trace.role: Declaring false is the shared act for which both addressees are made answerable.
The manifest human supplies one distinct witness class.
The hidden jinn supply the counterpart witness class.
Two opposed things arriving face to face models counterpart encounter.
A counterpart joined to its mate makes pairing a productive structure rather than duplication.

structural_cues: The focus has dual lord and denial suffixes within a surah patterned by sun and moon, two easts and wests, two seas, and paired gardens, springs, and fruits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pervasive pairing and two audience classes; I infer reciprocal witnessing between them. The live alternative is ordinary co-address without either class serving as evidence against the other.

changed_reading.before: One rhetorical question happens to address two populations.
changed_reading.after: The question places visible human and hidden jinn beside one another as counterwitnesses, so neither class can isolate its denial from the other's testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split mapping of the focus noun activates sequence, remainder, liability, and an answering voice. Contextual images of succession, recurrence, and connected series let the thirty prior refrains accumulate rather than reset; 55:77 is the final response slot carrying the remaining claim of everything before it.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence makes each recurrence inherit a position after what preceded it.
A remainder after prior material makes the final refrain carry unresolved residue.
A right or liability that follows its holder turns accumulated residue into a claim.
One voice following another supplies the antiphonal demand for an answering voice.
Succession in distinct segments supplies a contextual model for serial delivery.
A recurring appointment or allotted return gives repetition a due time and share.
A connected succession supplies continuity across otherwise separate scenes.

structural_cues: The packet records thirty occurrences of the same refrain before 55:77, which is its final occurrence immediately before the closing acclamation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial branch images and exact repetition; I infer that claims accumulate across repetitions and that the audience owes an answer. Alternatively, each recurrence may reset as a local rhetorical punctuation.

changed_reading.before: 55:77 repeats an isolated question after one more garden detail.
changed_reading.after: 55:77 is the final antiphonal ledger entry: the remaining claim of all prior displays follows the addressees and still awaits their answering voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: A just measure and the explicit matching of good action with good return turn the focus covenant branches into an account of reciprocity. Favors generate a claim for fitting acknowledgment, and denial defaults on that return.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability following its holder supplies the outstanding side of the account.
A lordly pact supplies the relation within which reciprocity is owed.
Fulfilling or failing a charge makes acknowledgment performative settlement.
A just balance supplies the norm for an adequate return.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies direct reciprocity.
Settling and collecting a debt sharpens reciprocity into an outstanding account.
Doing what is good supplies both the initiating act and its fitting response.

structural_cues: 55:60 places a matched good-for-good formula between two occurrences of the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies just measure, recompense, debt settlement, and matched goodness; I infer that divine giving calls for proportionate acknowledgment. Alternatively, the response may be free generosity rather than contractual debt.

changed_reading.before: Denial is failure to assent that gifts exist.
changed_reading.after: Denial is default on the fitting return of recognition generated by received goodness within a lordly pact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, growth, continuous provision, flourishing greenness, and stable increase make lordship a productive process. The favors are not a static inventory but stages and yields of cultivation; denial renders that formative process barren or unacknowledged.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion make lordship an ongoing formative process.
The split-root image of nourishment and growing up makes development explicit.
Creative origination supplies the beginning of the productive sequence.
Growing and being reared supply development between origin and maturity.
Continuous provision supplies the sustaining input of cultivation.
Flourishing freshness and ease supply the mature condition immediately before the focus.
Stable, growing good carries the productive process through the closing acclamation.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from created beings and planted food through flowing gardens to green furnishings and then closes with stable increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies origin, rearing, provision, flourishing, and stable increase; I connect them as stages of one lordly cultivation. A live alternative is a catalog of independent finished gifts rather than a developmental process.

changed_reading.before: The addressees are asked to count finished blessings.
changed_reading.after: They are asked which stages, sustaining inputs, and mature yields of their Lord's ongoing cultivation they will render fruitless by denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins side branches of lying directly to luxury textiles; it remains anchored because the focus falsehood root has a deceptive-cloth branch and the immediately preceding carpet root carries both precious-pattern and pure-lie branches, with an earlier furnishing root repeating the lie image. Render it as an exploratory material analogy, not as the lexical translation of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial verb follows the patterned furnishings of 55:76 and itself has a cloth-that-misrepresents branch.

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth that misrepresents its condition materializes falsehood as deceptive surface.
The furnishing root's lie branch plants falsehood inside the luxury-material field.
Fine patterned rugs provide the literal visible surface immediately before the focus.
Pure lie within that same carpet root makes visible splendor and counterfeit appearance coexist.

changed_reading.before: The final refrain challenges a spoken lie after a decorative detail.
changed_reading.after: The final refrain also probes false surface: will the addressees treat tangible splendor as counterfeit, or answer its displayed truth by clothing reality in a counterfeit appearance of their own?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping of the focus favor root; it remains worth carrying because its remainder and last-breath branches align tightly with perish, remain, the final refrain position, and stable closure. Downstream prose should label it a temporal-structural activation, never a replacement gloss for the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun's split mapping contributes remainder and last-breath branches at the final recurrence of the refrain.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what came before makes 55:77 the residue of the full refrain chain.
The last-breath image makes the final recurrence a terminal exhalation before closure.
Cessation and departure after persistence establish the vanishing side of the temporal contrast.
What remains after loss supplies the surviving residue that the final refrain carries.
Fixity in place receives the refrain's last breath into an enduring close.

changed_reading.before: The final refrain is one interchangeable repetition among many.
changed_reading.after: It can be heard as the chain's last breath and remainder, carrying the unresolved claim of what perishes into the fixed blessing of the closing Name.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-material transfer from lactation, running, seed, and water to human response; it remains anchored because the focus falsehood inventory explicitly includes failed expected yield and arrested movement while the context repeatedly supplies growth and sustained flow. Render it as a causal analogy for nonresponse, not as a dictionary sense imposed on the focus form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial root includes images of milk failing expectation and an animal beginning to run but stopping.

activation_trace.role: Milk that fails its expected yield models denial as non-delivery after promise.
Running followed by stopping models a productive response that aborts.
A seed that grows and bears grain supplies the expected-yield pattern.
Continuous provision supplies the sustaining flow to which response should correspond.
Water gushing abundantly supplies realized yield rather than withheld output.

changed_reading.before: The addressees utter an incorrect proposition.
changed_reading.after: The addressees become the failed-yield point in a productive circuit: provision arrives, but its expected fruit of recognition and return dries up or stops.

strongest_changes: The refrain becomes a calibration audit in which denial undercounts disclosed evidence and gives short measure.
The thirty prior refrains accumulate into an antiphonal claim, making 55:77 a final response slot rather than a reset.
Lordly favors become processes of cultivation and repair, allowing provision, boundary, warning, and consequence to coexist without collapsing into one tone.
Visible marks and emerging contents support an abductive reading in which denial rejects the passage from trace to concealed source.
The immediate furnishing cluster activates a contained false-surface reading in which material splendor and counterfeit appearance compete.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line supports several simultaneous mechanisms: favor-account, covenantal obligation, calibrated verdict, arrested response, reciprocal debt, paired counterwitness, cumulative refrain, cultivation, and deceptive surface. The split mappings are most productive when retained as explicit exploratory activators rather than used to replace the ordinary reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether judgment scenes count as reparative favors or instead contrast rejected favor with consequence remains open.
Whether repetition accumulates liability or locally resets at each scene remains a structural inference.
The non-dominant split-root remainder and last-breath readings are tightly placed but morphologically distant.
The textile and failed-yield mechanisms may be deliberate cross-domain echoes or merely live branch coincidences.
The dual may establish mutual witnessing between humans and jinn or simply address both classes together.
